Our approach, termed Sparse-Dense Embeddings Fusion (SDEF), leverages the strengths of sparse models for their ability to efficiently process large datasets and the dense models for their capacity to capture complex relationships in the data. Through extensive empirical evaluations on various benchmark datasets, we show that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art techniques, particularly in scenarios where traditional methods struggle due to limited labeled data availability.
